1.label: Preview app
1.detail: The profile menu sits above the assignment cards on the right, with a checkmark aligned to the right of Default.

2.label: Additional button 1
2.detail: MX Master 4 adds marker 6 on the thumb panel, while Additional button 1 sits in its own unnumbered row under Outside the diagram. Hovering marker 2 turns it amber and outlines the matching Back button row.

3.label: Gesture button tap
3.detail: The compact list pairs individual Win and Tab keycaps with the Task View label. The offline Preview app list uses the same treatment.

4.label: System
4.detail: The selected System category has a tinted background and amber icon, with Task View and desktop actions in the adjacent list. The compact picker keeps those columns and uses a dimmed backdrop.

5.label: No matching actions
5.detail: The empty search state puts Record a keyboard shortcut immediately below the message. A successful Copy search shows Ctrl and C keycaps before Assign.

6.label: Switch pointer speed
6.detail: Set up opens two side-by-side label and slider rows for 800 DPI and 1600 DPI, above a full-width amber Save pointer speed action button.

7.label: Saved shortcut
7.detail: After the save confirmation, the reopened and restarted editor show K in the Assigned now keycap and again in large type in the preview. The resized draft retains M in a compact inline keycap.

8.label: SmartShift
8.detail: The selected mode card uses an amber radio and border. Its Flick sensitivity slider shows 10 at the upper right, while High-resolution scrolling and Invert scroll direction have visibly opposite toggle positions.

9.label: Saved gesture actions
9.detail: When the main toggle is off, the page keeps the saved Tap and Swipe rows with amber direction icons and shortcut keycaps.

10.label: Switch to the window you want to add
10.detail: The window-pick banner uses a pointer icon and places the 4s countdown directly beside Cancel.

11.label: Disconnected
11.detail: A crossed-out mouse icon appears in a square beside the message, and the sidebar card swaps the green status and battery bar for a neutral dot.

12.label: Copy IDs
12.detail: The button sits at the right of Unnamed features, above two wrapping rows of monospace ID chips.

13.label: Couldn't save assignment
13.detail: A red warning triangle sits beside the heading, followed by Copy is still unsaved and two recovery buttons. Try again has the filled amber treatment.

14.label: Resume remapping
14.detail: The paused Windows menu changes the remapping item while keeping the checkmark beside Start with Windows.

1.label: Profile
1.detail: Default menu opens above the mapping cards, with Preview app as another choice.

2.label: Additional button 1
2.detail: MX Master 4 shows six numbered markers and a separate Outside the diagram card; hovering marker 2 highlights its matching card.

3.label: Gesture button tap
3.detail: Compact rows place the button name at left and keycaps plus the assignment at right.

4.label: System
4.detail: The selected category uses an amber tinted background and shows Task View and desktop actions alongside shortcut hints.

5.label: No matching actions
5.detail: The empty search result offers Record a keyboard shortcut.

6.label: Switch pointer speed
6.detail: The wheel action editor shows two sliders at 800 and 1600 DPI and a full-width save button.

7.label: Saved shortcut
7.detail: Recording shows Press a key, then a draft key and Save shortcut; reopening displays K and Saved.

8.label: SmartShift
8.detail: Three wheel mode cards sit above sensitivity sliders and two toggles.

9.label: Tap vs. swipe threshold
9.detail: A slider displays 60 counts above five tap and directional action rows.

10.label: Switch to the window you want to add
10.detail: An amber instruction banner includes a 4s countdown and Cancel.

11.label: Disconnected
11.detail: A wide status card asks the user to wake or reconnect the mouse.

12.label: HID++ features
12.detail: Named hexadecimal feature IDs appear in a large card, with unnamed ID chips below.

13.label: Couldn't save assignment
13.detail: A red warning icon precedes the error, with Try again and Back to editing buttons.

14.label: Pause remapping
14.detail: The tray menu includes a checked Start with Windows item and Quit Mushak.

1.label: Profile
1.detail: The Default dropdown opens above the mapping cards with a check beside Default and Preview app underneath, in both themes.

2.label: Outside the diagram
2.detail: MX Master 4 has six numbered markers and a separate Additional button 1 row. Hover turns marker 2 amber and outlines the matching Back button card.

3.label: Gesture button tap
3.detail: The compact list shows Win and Tab keycaps beside Task View, with Set swipes in Gestures beneath the button name.

4.label: Tabs & windows
4.detail: The category name wraps onto two lines in the narrow left column. System shows Task View, Desktop left, Desktop right and Show desktop in the right column.

5.label: No matching actions
5.detail: Searching Copy returns one Edit result with Ctrl and C keycaps and an Assign button. The empty result offers Record a keyboard shortcut.

6.label: Switch between two pointer speeds
6.detail: The editor has separate Speed 1: 800 DPI and Speed 2: 1600 DPI sliders above an amber full-width Save pointer speed action button.

7.label: Saved shortcut
7.detail: The ordered frames show recording, an M draft surviving the compact dialog, cancellation back to Native action, K saving with a toast, and reopening with K. The restarted image also visibly shows K.

8.label: Ignore accidental nudges
8.detail: SmartShift has an amber radio and border. The full settings view shows a value of 4 for accidental nudges and enabled high-resolution scrolling.

9.label: Saved gesture actions
9.detail: The off state keeps Tap and four swipe rows visible, removes the threshold slider, and explicitly says to turn on Button gestures to use them.

10.label: Switch to the window you want to add
10.detail: An amber capture banner shows a 4s countdown and Cancel above the Preview app profile. The ordered profile view has Move down and Move up controls.

11.label: Reapply settings
11.detail: Device cards show Bluetooth, firmware MPM 12.01.B0006, battery 50%, and Current DPI 1000. Separate empty and disconnected cards use a crossed mouse icon.

12.label: Unnamed features
12.detail: The diagnostic page separates named HID++ rows from two rows of hexadecimal chips and places Copy IDs beside the unnamed section.

13.label: Couldn't save assignment
13.detail: The local error says Copy is still unsaved and the previous assignment is active, followed by Try again and Back to editing. A separate conflict error shows Remapping enabled beside Try again.

14.label: Start with Windows
14.detail: Both native white tray menus show a check beside Start with Windows. Pause remapping changes to Resume remapping, with Quit Mushak below a separator.
